t: Announcing the Proposed Facilities Master Plan - The School District of Philadelphia
s: January 22, 2026 - The Plan contains recommendations for school buildings that make key investments including but not limited to: delivering access to Algebra I for every middle school student; investing in upgrades to existing Career and Technical Education (CTE) programming at three neighborhood high schools and a new 5th-12th grade CTE hub; investing in a new 5th-12th grade at the Arts Academy at Benjamin Rush; opening a new Academy at Palumbo Middle School and a new Bodine Middle School; increasing seats at five criteria-based schools; doubling the number of incoming students who have access to District-administered PreK; opening a K-8 and a 9-12 year-round choice and demonstration school; opening a new comprehensive high school program in the Northeast; and completing 56 Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) improvement projects.
